title: Obsidian Heel Solo #11 (옵시디언 솔로 · 체형 wide hip narrow · 힐 숫자 없음 · 검정 유리 신발)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, late 20s goddess, wide hip narrow physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — hips so impossibly wide extending beyond frame creating the most extreme hip-to-waist ratio ever, waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, upper body slim emphasizing the dramatic hip explosion, silver-white natural hair swept into a high sculpted crown — full body polished obsidian stone fused directly to her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is solid glossy black stone curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, with molten gold seams running between dozens of fitted stone sections, each seam standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, nothing lying flat. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING glossy jet-black obsidian surface across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID MOLTEN GOLD seams branching and converging densely with no plain stone section left ungilded, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Pose: full frontal, both hands framing the face, chin raised — most extreme wide hip narrow silhouette ever displayed.
extreme platform boots carved from the same glossy obsidian with gold seams, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts, extra long nails glossy black with gold seam tips.

MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Very low camera angle with the full length of every boot visible down to the floor, the towering heel height dominating the silhouette and lifting her far above the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
